summary: A repository of infrastructure as code: Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation/SAM, Pulumi, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Ansible.

resources-inventory.must: Every resource or module the code creates, by its logical id/name: type, purpose, environments, consumers. Group by stack/module.

environments.must: Every environment/workspace/stack instance, the parameters/variables each sets (never secret values), where state lives (backend, locking), accounts/subscriptions/projects and regions.

networking.must: VPCs/VNets, subnets, routing, peering/transit, DNS, ingress/egress, firewalls/security groups, private endpoints. Diagram when non-trivial.

cost.must: Main cost drivers, tagging strategy, budgets/alerts, known savings opportunities.

development.must: Tool versions, authentication to the cloud (profile/role, never credentials), format/validate/lint/plan commands, how to preview a change safely. Shell blocks labelled as run, copied or derived.

problem.must: What this infrastructure supports, who depends on it, what breaks if it goes away.

architecture.must: Diagram of the main resources and how traffic/data flows between them, per environment when they differ.

deploy.must: How changes are applied (pipeline, plan review, approvals, apply), drift detection, state handling, rollback strategy, blast-radius rules, change windows.

tests.must: Policy checks (cfn-guard, OPA, tfsec, checkov), unit/integration tests (Terratest, cdk assertions), plan-diff review; shell commands per check. Mark na only when there are none and say so in risks.

context.must: Applications and teams that consume this infrastructure, and other infra repos it depends on or feeds (shared VPC, DNS zones, accounts).
